name: Token Stats
author: Erik Burdett
description: Local LLM tokens per hour in the bar, with an exact-count graph, history and cloud comparison

barWidget.description: Tokens per hour in the bar, with a graph, history and savings versus a hosted API

schema.label: Bar shows
schema.description: Which window the number on the bar covers. The popup can show any of them.

schema.label: Refresh (seconds)
schema.description: One loopback request per resident model per refresh. 10s is plenty; counters are cumulative so nothing is missed between polls.

schema.label: Cloud price per 1M prompt tokens
schema.description: Set this to the API you would otherwise have used. Shown on the popup so the savings figure is never a hidden assumption.

schema.label: Cloud price per 1M cached prompt tokens
schema.description: Hosted APIs bill prompt tokens served from their cache at a reduced rate rather than free. Most local prompt tokens are cache hits, so this rate, not the full one, dominates the comparison. Default is a tenth of the prompt rate.

schema.label: System draw while generating (W)
schema.description: Used with the price below to cost the electricity your own hardware spent.

schema.label: llama-swap endpoint
schema.description: Loopback only. Anything else is ignored and the default is used.

schema.label: Import history from OpenCode
schema.description: Fills in tokens generated before this widget was installed, or while the shell was not running, using OpenCode's own exact per-reply counts. Read-only, local models only, and never double-counted.
